[[File:Werewolf icon.png|left]]
'''Werewolves''' are bipedal canine monsters found in [[Canifis]]. They have low [[defence]] for what their combat level suggests. Werewolves in Canifis appear as normal humans (level 28 with 1000 life points) until damaged, transforming into level 63 werewolves, unless the player wields [[Wolfbane]], in which case they remain human. It is not possible to kill their human form in one hit to prevent transformation, as the maximum hit against a human werewolf is 1,000, they then gain 1,250 health from transformation. Whether killed in human form or werewolf form, they will always drop [[wolf bones]].

Some [[Werewolf (God Wars Dungeon)|werewolves]] can be found in the [[God Wars Dungeon]]. They also have better defence and accuracy than their Canifis counterparts, and are also aggressive to players not wearing an item of [[Zamorak]]. They are spread out all over the dungeon, are most prevalent in [[Zamorak's Fortress]], but are not found in [[Bandos's Stronghold]]. Werewolves can be killed here for a Slayer assignment, but this is not recommended due to the remoteness and danger.

They only count towards a [[Werewolves (Slayer assignment)|werewolves slayer assignment]] when killed in werewolf form.

==Strategies==
While Wolfbane can prevent them from transforming (including using wolfbane and another off-hand weapon), its low stats can make kills relatively slow. The [[Sunspear (disambiguation)|reforged Sunspear]] can be used to prevent the transformation and is much stronger, but requires completion of [[River of Blood]].

Food is generally unnecessary in Canifis, as a bank is nearby and can be used to automatically heal. [[Roavar]] in the bar sells [[moonlight mead]] for 5 coins, which heals 440 life points with no negative effects. For low level players, werewolves can also be [[safe spot]]ted with Ranged or Magic over tables in the bar, the general store, or the meat shop.

[[File:Werewolf transform.gif|right|frame|A Werewolf transforming.|250x250px]]
[[File:Safe spotting a werewolf in Canifis.png|thumb|250x250px|A player using the safe spot in Rufus's food store to kill a werewolf.]]

Canifis can be used as a respawn hub. When the player dies, they can respawn in Canifis and pick up any dropped items quickly.

==Trivia==
* Werewolves used to drop hard clue scrolls but a hidden update changed this to medium clue scrolls.
* Werewolves were previously known as "Wolfman" and "Wolfwoman", and simply "Man" and "Woman" before they transformed.
* Killing a werewolf during transformation causes them to not play a death animation and instead freeze for a few seconds before disappearing.
* Causing a werewolf to transform and leaving it alone by running away will cause them to eventually change back in their human form, but retaining their werewolf health of 2,250.
